rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent stepped perimeter mass wrapped around a large central courtyard/void, and the four views agree on the same dominant logic. The access edge is responded to by the open court/undercut rather than a sealed frontage, which fits the neighborhood living brief. The silhouette is not just arbitrary stair-stepping: the steps consolidate into one massing rule, though the section remains somewhat generic and could be made more program-specific. Overall it is a plausible early-stage neighborhood building mass with strong public-space logic and acceptable hierarchy.
